name: concierge-memory-obsidian
description: Obsidian vault subagent (notes, project plans, reading/shopping lists) backed by the Obsidian Local REST API plugin over MCP.

vault_path.title: Vault path
vault_path.description: Absolute path to your Obsidian vault (informational — the actual connection goes through the REST API plugin's host/port below; this is used in the agent's own text so it knows what it's talking about).

api_key.title: Obsidian Local REST API key
api_key.description: From Obsidian > Settings > Community Plugins > Local REST API > API Key.

port.title: Obsidian REST API port
port.description: Port the Local REST API plugin listens on.
